purpose: Hands-off $100-first growth autopilot with automatic protective exits, expectancy scoring, adaptive sizing, loss brakes, profit locks, correlation controls, explicit asset routing, and user-only funding.

funding.instructions: Use only cash and trading proceeds already inside the dedicated Robinhood Agentic account. Never pull money from any external account. Only the user may manually add more money.

sizing.instructions: Read current non-margin cash buying power and total Agentic-account equity on every run. Apply hard floor, capital ladder, portfolio guard, circuit breakers, profit lock, trade-frequency guard, and correlation guard before the smaller Teststock allocation/risk limit. Never initiate funding.

hardAccountFloor.instructions: If live Agentic-account equity is below $75, do not open any new position. Manage and close existing positions only. Do not add money automatically. Normal new-trade eligibility may resume only after live equity is at least $80 and every other guard passes.

capitalLadder.basis: Current dedicated Robinhood Agentic-account equity. Manual user deposits are allowed; the agent may never initiate them.
capitalLadder.instructions: Select exactly one tier using lower-bound-inclusive, upper-bound-exclusive intervals: >=0 and <80 RECOVERY; >=80 and <100 DEFENSE; >=100 and <125 PROVE; >=125 and <150 SCALE; >=150 GROWTH. Exactly $80 is DEFENSE, exactly $100 is PROVE, exactly $125 is SCALE, and exactly $150 is GROWTH. Never choose the lower tier at an exact boundary. Multiply stock allocation by stockAllocationMultiplier. Never exceed tier maxDeployedPct or planned-stop-risk cap. For options, premium paid must fit the smaller of the live option-policy cap and tier.maxOptionRiskPct. Planned loss at the encoded option stop must also fit tier.maxOptionPlannedStopRiskPct. If the tier disables options, do not open one.

profitLock.instructions: Before a new trade, estimate total planned stop-loss across all open Teststock positions plus the proposed trade. Do not intentionally size a new trade so that equity minus total planned stop-loss falls below the active protected floor. Floors reduce planned risk but cannot prevent gaps or slippage.

financialRiskGate.dataSource: Live Robinhood get_portfolio (equity, cash, buying_power) plus get_equity_positions/get_option_positions and the crypto autopilot's own Robinhood Crypto API balance check, for the dedicated Agentic account only. Never any external bank, checking, savings, credit card, other brokerage, or manually remembered balance -- if it did not come from a fresh Robinhood read this run, it does not count.
financialRiskGate.instructions: Before proposing or submitting any new stock, option, or crypto entry, compute remainingRiskBudgetDollars live from Robinhood data only: start from current Agentic-account equity and non-margin buying power; subtract the reserve required by hardAccountFloor (never trade equity below noNewTradesBelowEquity), the active profitLock protected floor, and the sum of already-committed planned stop-loss risk across every open Teststock position across all asset classes. Cap the remainder by the current capitalLadder tier's maxPlannedStopRiskPct and maxDeployedPct of equity, whichever is smaller. If Robinhood account data cannot be freshly and fully read this run, or any required figure is missing, unavailable, or stale, treat remainingRiskBudgetDollars as exactly $0 -- never estimate, assume, or reuse a previous run's number. A remainingRiskBudgetDollars of $0 or less is a valid, expected, and frequent outcome: the only allowed action is DO_NOT_TRADE (existing positions may still be managed/exited); do not open any new position in any asset class no matter how strong the signal looks. This gate is additive: it never replaces or loosens hardAccountFloor, capitalLadder, profitLock, circuitBreakers, tradeFrequencyGuard, correlationGuard, or portfolioGuard, and none of those may be loosened to make room for a trade this gate would otherwise block.
externalDataSourcesForbidden: any brokerage account other than the dedicated Robinhood Agentic account
manually asserted, remembered, or estimated balances not freshly read from Robinhood this run

circuitBreakers.instructions: If live Robinhood account history exposes reliable day P&L and 7-day high-water/equity data, open no new positions when current-day loss is 3% or more or 7-day drawdown is 6% or more. Continue managing exits. If the needed history is unavailable, do not invent it; fall back to capitalLadder and outcomeGuard.

tradeFrequencyGuard.instructions: Up to four independently qualified new positions per day and 10 per rolling 7 days. These are ceilings, never quotas; all smaller cash, risk, event, correlation, execution, protection, and real-fill limits override them.

correlationGuard.instructions: The authoritative correlation source is docs/data/portfolio-correlation.json, which computes real live 90-day return correlation across whatever the current scan actually discovered (no fixed ticker list, no hardcoded default). illustrativeSectorGroupsOnly is a small set of well-known-name examples for human readability only; it never limits or substitutes for the live correlation data and must never be treated as the complete or authoritative cluster list. Avoid stacking highly correlated bets: do not open more than one new position from the same live high-correlation cluster (>=0.75) at full size; a second name from the same cluster is at most half size; a third is blocked. Existing exposure should make new correlated entries smaller or ineligible.

executionQuality.instructions: Prefer limit orders when supported. Never pay above maximumEntry. Skip a new entry when the live bid/ask spread exceeds the applicable cap or when executable pricing is materially worse than the signal. A missed trade is better than a bad fill.

gapRiskGuard.instructions: Use reliable prior close and current regular-session open when available. Skip or wait for revalidation if the absolute opening gap exceeds 4% or consumes more than 50% of planned entry-to-stop distance. Never widen a stop for a gap.

liquidityRanking.instructions: When multiple otherwise-qualified candidates exist, prefer tighter live spread, higher reliable dollar volume, and cleaner historical fills. A missed trade is better than poor liquidity.

exitAutomation.stockProtection: Determine the live stock quantity. For whole-share quantity, create and verify a broker-resident persistent protective stop when Robinhood accepts it. Do not retry unsupported trigger orders for a fractional remainder. Fractional quantity may use only signal.fractionalProtectionPolicy synthetic monitoring, and only while its monitoring/risk requirements pass.
exitAutomation.optionProtection: After an option buy fills, immediately place a persistent sell-to-close protective stop-market or stop-limit order when the connected Robinhood option tool supports that order type. Verify the protective order is accepted and covers the full intended contract quantity.
exitAutomation.cryptoProtection: If crypto execution becomes supported by the connected Robinhood tools, place the strongest supported persistent protective exit at or near the Teststock invalidation immediately after entry.
exitAutomation.noProtectionNoEntry: Whole-share stock or option entries still require verified broker-resident protection when supported. A fractional stock entry may proceed only under signal.fractionalProtectionPolicy with active <=5-minute regular-session monitoring and the smaller 0.75%-of-live-equity planned-stop-risk cap. If those synthetic-protection requirements are not verifiably available, do not open the fractional entry.
exitAutomation.target1: At target1, sell about 25% of the ORIGINAL position when practical, then protect the remaining quantity at breakeven or tighter without widening risk.
exitAutomation.target2: At target2, use runnerContinuationPolicy. Sell enough of the ORIGINAL position to leave at most the authorized runner: normally 50% at target2 for a strong 25% runner, 60% for a moderate 15% runner, or all remaining 75% if no runner is authorized.
exitAutomation.bracketCaution: Do not assume bracket/OCO support. If the broker/tool does not support linked bracket orders, sequence protective-order changes and profit-taking carefully and verify quantities after every fill.
exitAutomation.runner: Never keep a runner solely because the original plan wanted one. It must be re-authorized by a fresh current Teststock continuation signal and remain under verified tightened protection.

healthGuard.instructions: If Teststock is stale, Robinhood tools are unavailable, order status is unknown, a protective order cannot be verified, account equity/buying power is missing, or an unexpected partial fill/duplicate appears, open no new positions. Resolve or safely manage existing exposure first. Never guess an order filled or a stop exists.

portfolioGuard.instructions: Target up to eight concurrent independently qualified Teststock stock positions, ranked best-first. Each must independently pass every gate and the combined portfolio must stay within the smallest deployed-cash, planned-stop-risk, correlation, event, execution, and protection caps. If fewer than eight qualify, hold the remainder in cash rather than forcing a weaker trade.

autopilot.scope: Dedicated Robinhood Agentic account; stock execution only. Crypto execution is disabled. Qualified stock options may execute automatically under the separate cash-only options policy.

assetClassRouting.OPTION: Use only stockPlan.eliteOption and only when its action is AUTO_BUY_ELIGIBLE.
assetClassRouting.CRYPTO: Use only cryptoPlan.cryptoOrders. Never treat a crypto symbol as a stock or option.

hardRules: FUNDING LOCK: never initiate a deposit, ACH transfer, debit-card transfer, bank transfer, wire, internal transfer, or any other movement of money into the Robinhood Agentic account.
Only the user may manually add capital. Trading profits may remain and be reused inside the Agentic account.
Never access, withdraw from, charge, or borrow against any external bank, card, credit line, retirement account, or other financial account.

HARD ACCOUNT FLOOR: below $75 live Agentic-account equity, manage exits only and open no new trades. Do not auto-fund. Resume new-trade eligibility only at $80 or more and only if all other guards pass.
CAPITAL TIER BOUNDARIES: >=0/<80 RECOVERY; >=80/<100 DEFENSE; >=100/<125 PROVE; >=125/<150 SCALE; >=150 GROWTH. Exactly $100 is PROVE. Never select the lower tier at an exact boundary.

FINANCIAL RISK GATE: before any new stock, option, or crypto entry, compute remainingRiskBudgetDollars live from Robinhood account data only (never external bank/card/other-brokerage data). A $0-or-less budget is a valid, expected outcome and forces DO_NOT_TRADE for every asset class; missing or stale Robinhood data also forces the budget to $0.

Apply financialRiskGate, capitalLadder, profitLock, circuitBreakers, tradeFrequencyGuard, correlationGuard, executionQuality, exitAutomation, healthGuard, portfolioGuard, and outcomeGuard before every new position.
Use only existing non-margin cash buying power. Never use margin, borrowed funds, naked options, short stock, leveraged crypto, or undefined-risk option positions.
Never confuse asset classes: STOCK orders come only from stockPlan.stockOrders, OPTION orders come only from stockPlan.eliteOption, and CRYPTO orders come only from cryptoPlan.cryptoOrders.
A stock must pass Teststock expectancy, adaptive-performance, historical sample, reward/risk, market/sector/intraday, freshness, and entry gates. Never loosen a failed gate to force a trade.

For stocks use the smallest amount allowed by the ladder-adjusted Teststock allocation, tier planned-stop-risk cap, tier max-deployed cap, profit-lock floor, trade-frequency guard, correlation guard, and available non-margin cash.

Options are exceptional, not default. They require every eliteOption check, exact contract verification, acceptable live spread/liquidity, the active ladder tier to allow options, the smaller option-risk cap, and a verified protective exit capability.

After every supported new stock or option fill, immediately create and verify the strongest supported persistent protective exit at the saved Teststock invalidation. If a persistent protective exit cannot be created or verified, do not open that new position.
Never add to a losing position and never move a protective exit farther away from the entry.

Before every trade verify live executable price, spread, current Agentic-account buying power/equity, existing positions, open orders, signal expiration, daily/weekly trade counts when available, and correlation with existing exposure.
Prefer limit orders when supported; never pay above maximumEntry and skip entries with excessive spread/slippage.
Do not buy below minimumEntry or above maximumEntry. If price is outside the range, wait.
Crypto may be executed only if the connected Robinhood tools explicitly expose crypto order placement at runtime; otherwise crypto remains signal-only.
Obey outcomeGuard. Weak recent resolved performance or multiple consecutive losses reduce size, lock options, or pause new trades.
Obey circuit breakers when reliable account-history data is available; circuit breakers stop new entries but do not prevent protective exits.
If Teststock, Robinhood, order status, or protective-order status materially disagree or cannot be verified, do not open a new trade.
Unused capital stays in cash. Never increase risk to chase a return target or recover losses.

Manage exits automatically: invalidation means exit/protective stop; target1 means protect gains and consider partial profit; target2 means prioritize profit capture. The user should not need to calculate stops manually.
No model, stop, profit lock, or automation can guarantee profit or prevent losses, gaps, slippage, option decay, crypto volatility, or tool failures.
DUAL HOLDOUT: use separate 2024-2025 and 2026+ untouched validation. A failure blocks/reduces the affected regime; sparse second-holdout evidence reduces risk.
REGIME-SPECIFIC ENTRIES: use stricter regime profiles for calm, volatile, trending-down, trending-up, mixed, and unknown environments; never loosen base probability gates.

TOP EIGHT STOCK PORTFOLIO: rank stocks best-first and target up to eight independently qualified stock positions held concurrently. Never force a weak position just to fill capacity; unused capacity stays cash. New entries still stay within 4 new positions/day and 12 per rolling 7 days as ceilings only, and all total-risk, cash, cluster, event, spread, protection, and circuit-breaker limits still apply.

TARGET2 QUALIFICATION: use target2 for the minimum reward/risk entry gate. Target1 is a partial-profit/de-risking milestone and must not incorrectly disqualify a setup whose full target satisfies the required asymmetry.

CONDITIONAL RUNNER: at target1 sell about 25% of the original stock position and tighten protection. At target2 leave at most a 25% runner only if a fresh current continuation signal is strong; leave 15% for moderate continuation; otherwise exit the full remainder. Any runner must remain under verified tightened protection and may never be kept on stale/missing/weak evidence.

COST-ADJUSTED EXPECTANCY: subtract the encoded conservative execution-friction allowance before stock eligibility/ranking. Never rank a nominal edge above a stronger after-cost edge merely because costs were ignored.
CROSS-ASSET PRIORITY: rank already-qualified stocks, options, and crypto by risk-adjusted opportunity, but ranking never overrides live eligibility or safety gates and never creates a quota.
SYMBOL PROBATION: lightly tested symbols start at reduced size until historical and real-fill evidence improves.
GAP + LIQUIDITY: avoid large opening gaps, never widen stops for gaps, and prefer tighter spreads/higher reliable dollar volume among otherwise-equal candidates.

OPTIONS + CRYPTO REMAIN SELECTIVE: they may participate when all dedicated research, real-fill, broker, whole-contract/liquidity/protection and frequency gates pass; frequency permission is never a reason to force a trade.
PIPELINE FRESHNESS: dataFreshness.lastSuccessfulGeneration and per-asset ages are machine-readable. A stale dependency fails closed; never hide a stalled generator by extending validity windows.

FRACTIONAL STOP LIMITATION: the connected Robinhood Agentic runtime has rejected triggered stop orders for fractional share quantities with Invalid trigger for fractional order. Do not repeatedly retry unsupported stop-market/stop-limit fractional orders.

FRACTIONAL SYNTHETIC PROTECTION: a new fractional stock entry is permitted only if active regular-session monitoring can be verified at intervals of 5 minutes or less and planned stop risk is capped at 0.75% of live equity. When the saved invalidation is observed as breached, submit the supported fractional market sell immediately when permitted and verify the result.

WHOLE/HYBRID PROTECTION: use a verified broker-resident stop for whole-share quantity when supported; for mixed quantities, reconcile the whole-share broker stop with the synthetic fractional remainder so combined sell orders can never exceed the live position.

SYNTHETIC STOP HONESTY: an agent-managed fractional stop is not persistent broker protection and cannot guarantee the planned exit. If monitoring becomes unavailable, do not add fractional risk and do not keep a fractional runner unattended.

bestAcceptableEntryPolicy.bTier: Positive-expectancy best-acceptable entries after A-tier priority while live capacity remains; 25% micro-probation candidate-size multiplier.
bestAcceptableEntryPolicy.rule: Process live qualified A candidates first, then qualified B candidates at no more than 25% encoded normal size while live capacity remains, including after an A fill. Keep scanning after each completed or rejected setup.

runtimeGapGuard.rule: At runtime compare current session open with prior regular-session close when reliable. Skip after an absolute opening gap above 4%, or when the gap consumes more than 50% of planned entry-to-stop distance, unless explicitly revalidated. Never widen the stop.

runtimeLiquidityRanking.rankingBasis: Cost-adjusted expectancy is emphasized and reported spread is penalized before live broker verification. Live Robinhood spread remains authoritative.
runtimeLiquidityRanking.minimumReliableDollarVolume: Prefer highly liquid names; reject clearly illiquid candidates when reliable dollar volume is available.

candidateQueuePolicy.rule: Try candidates in queue order. Every primary or reserve must pass all live gates and live sizing. Never weaken a gate to reach four; hold cash if all fail.

bestAcceptableEntryPolicy.executionRule: Buy the highest-ranked live A candidate when one survives every live guard at up to its normal encoded size. If no A survives, buy the highest-ranked live B candidate at no more than one-quarter of normal candidate size as a micro-probation entry. If the selected candidate fails before submission, keep trying eligible fallbacks in the same run. Hold cash only when no A or B survives every hard guard.

execution.note: At runtime, use crypto order tools only if the connected Robinhood MCP actually exposes them.

CALM.reason: At least one adequately sampled untouched holdout failed a robustness gate.

VOLATILE.reason: Untouched holdout samples are too thin to judge robustness; keep reduced stock size and collect more data.

TRENDING_DOWN.reason: Untouched holdout samples are too thin to judge robustness; keep reduced stock size and collect more data.

TRENDING_UP.reason: Both untouched holdouts remained positive under the regime-specific entry profile.

MIXED.reason: MIXED is intentionally disabled because development performance is non-viable.

UNKNOWN.reason: Untouched holdout samples are too thin to judge robustness; keep reduced stock size and collect more data.

entryGateRobustness.instructions: Do not tune from either holdout. CALM must earn promotion on pre-2024 calibration then survive both untouched slices. MIXED stays disabled. VOLATILE, TRENDING_DOWN and UNKNOWN stay reduced while sparse. TRENDING_UP is the highest research priority because both untouched slices currently confirm it.
entryGateRobustness.interpretation: Development, first untouched holdout, and second untouched confirmation holdout are kept separate. Regime-specific profiles are stricter-or-equal overlays and may never loosen base gates.

summary.note: Diagnostic only. One same-day symbol/decision/setup episode contributes at most one statistical observation; variants are retained as metadata. Shadow outcomes may support profitability admission but must never loosen a hard live-money gate.

probabilityFirstPolicy.objective: Increase the probability of positive compounding while keeping stocks primary, options exceptional, crypto active around the clock, and cash acceptable. Prefer elite A stocks at normal encoded size, allow a tightly capped B best-acceptable micro-probation stock after A-tier priority whenever live capacity remains, and let crypto surface more reasonable 24/7 opportunities without removing hard risk controls. This policy cannot eliminate market loss risk.

bestAcceptable.rule: B is a micro-probation fallback capped at one-quarter of normal candidate size, not a waiver. It must still have bullish direction, positive conservative expectancy, adequate history, acceptable R:R, bounded volatility, and every downstream live account/execution/protection guard.

seedLane.rule: Legacy swing stock seed lane is disabled under evidence-first day trading; retained only as configuration history. It may bypass only the forward profitability-admission wait at up to a $30 ceiling for A-tier candidates (raised from $20); a B-tier (best-acceptable) candidate is now also seed-lane eligible but stays capped at $7.50 (25% of the A-tier ceiling), matching this policy's existing B-tier micro-probation sizing elsewhere. Up to 3 concurrent positions and 2 new positions per UTC day (raised from 2/1). Every research, freshness, entry-zone, no-chase, decision-intelligence, buying-power, account-floor, portfolio, duplicate-order and protection gate remains mandatory. LIVE_SUSPENDED and contradictory shadow evidence never qualify. A fractional-only fill (common at this size) has no broker-resident stop available on Robinhood -- this lane uses the same agent-managed synthetic-stop protection already defined for fractional positions elsewhere (fractionalProtectionPolicy), including its tighter 0.75%-of-equity planned-stop-risk cap and mandatory active-monitoring requirement, rather than requiring an impossible broker-resident stop.

dayTradeSeedLane.rule: User-authorized same-day stock seed lane, expanded 2026-09-18 at user request for more trades/day and larger size. It reuses the swing seed candidate pool, never overlaps a swing selection, accepts entries only during the authoritative regular session with at least 20 minutes to close (matching the system-wide day-trader policy), and requires repeated forced-exit dispatches from 10 minutes before close until Robinhood confirms the position is flat. Up to a $30 ceiling for A-tier candidates (raised from $20); a B-tier (best-acceptable) candidate is now also day-trade-seed-lane eligible but stays capped at $7.50 (25% of the A-tier ceiling). Up to 5 concurrent positions and 5 new positions per UTC day (raised from 3/3). A fractional-only fill (common at this size) has no broker-resident stop available on Robinhood -- this lane uses the same agent-managed synthetic-stop protection already defined for fractional positions elsewhere (fractionalProtectionPolicy), including its tighter 0.75%-of-equity planned-stop-risk cap and mandatory active-monitoring requirement, rather than requiring an impossible broker-resident stop. Synthetic protection still requires the same <=5 minute active-monitoring cadence during the regular session as the swing lane, separate from this lane's own forced-exit timing. Profit target tightened 2026-09-22 (user-requested day-trade-only phase): target1/target2 for this lane use targetPct1/targetPct2 (2%/3% above entry) instead of the shared swing 1.5R/2.6R geometry, since the goal is small, frequent, same-day gains rather than a multi-day swing target -- stop/invalidation logic is unchanged.

winningPositionAddOn.rule: A fresh A-tier trigger may add at most $20 to an already-held Teststock stock only when the live position is profitable by at least 1%, no equivalent order is pending, no add-on was submitted for that symbol today, combined portfolio risk remains inside every cap, and protection is preserved or tightened. Never average down or widen the stop.

stocks.instructions: Target2 is the qualification target; target1 is for partial profit/de-risking. Use cost-adjusted conservative expectancy when available so execution friction cannot be ignored. A tier always ranks before B tier. A candidates may use their normal encoded size only after every downstream runtime and broker guard passes. B candidates remain capped at 25% micro-probation size. The automatic seed lane uses only existing dedicated Robinhood cash and can never deposit, transfer, borrow or use margin.

seedLane.rule: Small-account option lane: up to 8 cash-funded long options per UTC week (max 1 concurrent), with a $20 premium cap per new contract so one-contract sizing can fit a roughly $100 account without using margin. STANDARD contracts remain preferred, but liquid WEEKLY contracts may qualify after live spread, volume/open-interest, IV, momentum and tradability checks. Day-trader style: bank profits fast. Take-profit objective is 1.35x entry premium (+35%); protection moves to break-even at +15%, locks at least +10% once up 25%, and trails no lower than 15% below the high-water mark once up 35%. Stop stays at 0.65x premium (-35%) and protection may only move upward. Entry uses a marketable limit within the encoded premium cap. All positions must be sold to close before the session ends -- never hold to expiration.

options.instructions: Small-account option entries use relaxed research thresholds so more legitimate setups can qualify, but live broker data, positive cost-adjusted expectancy, liquidity, tradability, buying power and defined-risk controls remain mandatory. ChatGPT must confirm live contract data before entry. One whole contract must still fit both the active capital-tier premium cap and the option-specific planned-stop-risk cap. The lane should prefer an affordable qualifying contract rather than blocking on a higher-scoring contract that is too expensive.

dayTradeSeedLane.rule: User-authorized automatic crypto learning lane through ChatGPT and the authenticated Robinhood Trading MCP. It may bypass only the forward-shadow admission wait at a fixed $5 ceiling; every research, freshness, liquidity, spread, no-chase, Robinhood tradability, buying-power, duplicate-order and protection gate still applies. LIVE_SUSPENDED never qualifies. Restricted to A+ only 2026-09-22 (user-requested: "don't buy crypto as a day trader unless it's good") -- plain A grade (generate-crypto-picks.mjs's grade()) requires only growthQuality>=84/score>=78/atrPct<=12 and lets thin historical evidence bypass the win-rate bar entirely (historyA: samples<6||win>=50), while A+ demands growthQuality>=92/score>=86/atrPct<=11 and real sample-backed evidence (historyAPlus: samples>=10&&win>=56) -- a materially stronger, not just technically-qualified, setup.

crypto.instructions: Crypto runs 24/7, so the research gate is intentionally more permissive than before to surface more plausible A/A+ setups. Keep positive historical tendency, 4-hour confirmation, BTC context for altcoins, liquidity, defined stops, no leverage, no averaging down, and one-position-at-a-time controls. Broker execution availability remains a separate hard gate.

A higher-ranked item must still pass every live account, broker, entry, spread, gap, event, real-fill, protection, cash, correlation, frequency, and risk check. Never force a trade because it ranks first.

symbolProbationPolicy.instructions: New or lightly tested symbols start smaller. Historical sample depth and real Robinhood fills can promote a symbol; weak symbol-level real-fill performance can reduce or block it. Probation never increases risk.

dataFreshness.instructions: This block is regenerated on every successful publish attempt. If lastSuccessfulGeneration or an asset signal age exceeds its stale threshold, treat that dependency as stale and open no new position from it.

journal reconciliation or reliable Robinhood-history reconstruction
active <=5-minute monitoring for any new fractional stock exposure
systemHealth.instructions: Any missing, stale, contradictory, or unknown critical dependency means no new position.

performanceScalingGuard.instructions: Equity alone never unlocks higher risk; confirmed real-fill evidence caps the effective risk tier.

runnerContinuationPolicy.runnerSizingRule: At target2, sell enough of the ORIGINAL position so only the currently-authorized runner remains. Strong continuation: leave 25% runner (normally sell 50% at target2 after 25% sold at target1). Moderate continuation: leave 15% runner (sell 60% at target2). Weak, missing, stale, contradictory, or blocked continuation: leave 0% runner (sell all 75% remaining at target2).

protection.afterTarget1: Protect the remaining position at breakeven or tighter when supported; never widen risk.
protection.afterTarget2: Any runner must have a verified tightened persistent protective exit. Tighten only; never move protection farther away. If protection cannot be verified, exit the runner.
protection.trailingMethod: Use the strongest supported trailing/tightening mechanism available from the broker/agent. Do not invent an unsupported trailing order.
protection.fractionalRunnerRule: A fractional runner requires both continuation authorization and healthy active synthetic-stop monitoring under signal.fractionalProtectionPolicy. Without that monitoring, exit the fractional runner instead of leaving it unattended.

runnerContinuationPolicy.instructions: Exit shape is constrained by exitPolicyValidation. T1_25_T2_75 is currently authorized. Missing/stale validation falls back to T1_25_T2_75 with no runner. A continuation signal may only REDUCE the authorized runner; it may never exceed the validated maximum.

observedPlatformConstraint.interpretation: The connected Robinhood Agentic order path rejected stop-market and stop-limit trigger orders for fractional share quantities. Do not keep retrying unsupported triggered fractional orders.

protectionHierarchy: For whole-share quantity, prefer a verified broker-resident persistent stop/stop-limit when the runtime accepts it.
For a mixed position, protect the whole-share portion with a broker-resident stop when supported and treat only the fractional remainder as synthetic-stop exposure.
For a position below one full share, no broker trigger may be assumed. Fractional protection is agent-managed synthetic protection only when active monitoring is healthy.
Never describe a synthetic stop as broker-resident, guaranteed, or equivalent to a persistent stop.

fractionalSyntheticStop.triggerRule: When a reliable live Robinhood price at or below the saved Teststock stop/invalidation is observed, submit a fractional market sell for the protected fractional quantity immediately when runtime permissions allow. Re-read position/order status after submission and never infer a fill.
fractionalSyntheticStop.monitoringFailureRule: If active monitoring cannot be verified during the regular session, do not open new fractional stock exposure. Existing synthetic-only fractional exposure is DEGRADED/UNPROTECTED; do not add risk. If runtime permissions allow automatic risk reduction, exit the synthetic-only fractional quantity rather than knowingly leaving it unattended.
fractionalSyntheticStop.marketClosedRule: Do not pretend an agent-managed stop can execute while monitoring/order routing is unavailable. Re-check immediately when the regular session becomes actionable. Gap/slippage can exceed the planned stop.
fractionalSyntheticStop.slippageWarning: A synthetic stop is not a resting broker order. Detection latency, outages, usage limits, gaps, fast markets, and market-order slippage can produce losses materially larger than planned.

mixedQuantity.rule: Let wholeQty=floor(live share quantity) and fractionalRemainder=live quantity-wholeQty. When supported, protect wholeQty with a broker-resident stop and protect only fractionalRemainder synthetically. Before any sell, reconcile open sell orders so combined sell quantity cannot exceed the live position.

targetManagement.target1: Fractional partial profit may use the supported fractional sell path. After target1, whole shares should retain/tighten broker protection when supported; any fractional remainder remains subject to synthetic monitoring rules.
targetManagement.target2: Apply runnerContinuationPolicy, but a fractional runner is allowed only while active monitoring satisfies this policy. If monitoring is not healthy, leave no synthetic-only fractional runner.
targetManagement.runner: A fractional runner may never survive solely because continuation is strong. Both continuation evidence AND active synthetic-stop monitoring must pass.

existingFractionalPositionResponse.firstAction: Inspect live quantity, open orders, saved Teststock stop/invalidation, current price, and runtime monitoring capability.
existingFractionalPositionResponse.ifStopBreached: Submit the supported fractional market sell immediately when permitted, then verify the fill/remaining quantity.
existingFractionalPositionResponse.ifStopNotBreachedButMonitoringHealthy: Keep the saved invalidation as a synthetic trigger, apply the reduced synthetic-risk policy to any future entries, and monitor at the required interval.
existingFractionalPositionResponse.ifMonitoringNotHealthy: Mark protection DEGRADED, open no additional fractional risk, and prefer reducing/closing synthetic-only exposure when automatic risk reduction is permitted rather than pretending it is protected.

fractionalProtectionPolicy.instructions: Fractional-share protection is a degraded fallback forced by the observed broker limitation, not an upgrade. New fractional entries are allowed only when active monitoring can enforce the saved invalidation at least every 5 minutes during the regular session and planned stop risk is no more than 0.75% of live equity. Otherwise skip the fractional entry. Whole-share broker protection remains preferred.

wholeShareTieBreaker.rule: Only after eligibility and opportunity quality are effectively tied, prefer the candidate whose live allowed allocation can purchase at least 1 whole share so broker-resident protection may be available.

fractionalOnlyFallback.note: GitHub/Alpaca detect triggers and publish a compact dispatch packet without an LLM. Detection alone is not a broker stop; a timely authorized execution run is still needed.

exitPolicyValidation.recommendationReason: The no-runner baseline was the strongest policy in development, so no runner policy is promoted.

modelSizingPolicy.instructions: Backtests, scanner history, and shadow data may rank or reduce risk but never increase live allocation.

policy.instructions: Among otherwise-qualified stocks, prefer lower-correlation combinations. One name per >=0.75 cluster may use normal eligible size; a second must be no more than half its otherwise-allowed size; a third from the same cluster is blocked. Never use correlation to increase size.

promotionPolicy.instructions: A challenger may replace the exit shape only after the existing validation script authorizes it. It may never increase entry size, loosen a stop, bypass a safety gate, or force a trade.

policy.note: Adaptive evidence can only reorder already-qualified candidates or reduce/block risk. It cannot create eligibility, increase maximum risk, loosen validation, or override account/protection rules.

executionLearningPolicy.instructions: Use confirmed real Robinhood fills to adjust priority among already-qualified Teststock candidates. Require minimum samples, recency weighting and shrinkage. Never let learning create a trade, raise maximum live risk, loosen validation, override a blocked regime, or override account/protection safety gates.

postTradeAttributionPolicy.instructions: After a resolved real trade, attribute what helped or hurt only when the evidence is observable. Multiple categories may apply. UNKNOWN is preferred over guessing.

setupSpecificExitResearch.instructions: Global validated exit policy remains live. Setup-specific exits may be studied in shadow and promoted only after separate untouched holdout evidence is sufficient.

liveTradeStatePolicy.instructions: Never infer live holdings from Teststock planning data. Live holdings/fills come only from Robinhood. Unknown or contradictory live state blocks new risk.

portfolioHeatPolicy.instructions: Calculate portfolio heat from live Robinhood positions plus saved Teststock invalidations. Missing live quantities/prices means UNKNOWN and blocks new entries.

signalDriftPolicy.instructions: Immediately before a buy compare live executable price with the fresh signal. Revalidate/skip when drift exceeds 1% or consumes more than 25% of the entry-to-stop distance. Never widen the stop or chase.

triggers: latest Teststock workflow failed/cancelled/timed out or signal is stale
Robinhood balances, positions, orders or fills are contradictory/unknown

fractional-only position is not armed in the execution watchlist

real execution slippage/protection reliability crosses encoded live brakes
automationKillSwitch.resetRule: Only resume new entries after the triggering condition is positively verified healthy. Time passing alone does not clear the kill switch.
automationKillSwitch.instructions: Never liquidate blindly. Manage existing exits by the safest supported path and open no new positions while a critical fault remains.

dayTradeOnlyEntryPolicy.objective: Take small, frequent, same-day gains to build the account up before returning to larger multi-day swing targets (user-requested 2026-09-22, given the PDT day-trade-count restriction was eliminated by FINRA effective 2026-06-04 -- confirmed already implemented by Robinhood -- so frequent same-day stock entries are no longer capped at 3 per 5 business days).
dayTradeOnlyEntryPolicy.existingSwingPositionsNote: Positions already open before this policy (tracked in execution-watchlist.json) continue to their existing saved stop/target1/target2 unchanged and are never force-closed by this policy. Only NEW stock entries are affected.
dayTradeOnlyEntryPolicy.mechanism: While enabled, update-trigger-board.mjs never emits a new BUY_TRIGGER or SEED_LANE_BUY_TRIGGER (both swing, no forced same-day exit) for stocks -- new stock entries can only come from STOCK_DAY_TRADE_SEED_LANE_BUY_TRIGGER, which already requires flattening by close and now uses a tighter 2%/3% target1/target2 (probabilityFirstPolicy.stocks.dayTradeSeedLane.targetPct1/targetPct2) instead of the shared swing 1.5R/2.6R geometry. Crypto day-trade-seed-lane entries are unaffected (crypto was never subject to PDT and already uses a bounded max-holding-window lane).
dayTradeOnlyEntryPolicy.revertInstruction: Once the account has demonstrated it can make money on the tighter day-trade lane, set enabled:false here to resume normal swing-lane stock entries (BUY_TRIGGER/SEED_LANE_BUY_TRIGGER). This is a single flag flip; no other file needs to change to revert.

smallAccountAccessPolicy.instructions: A cheaper whole-share stock may not replace a materially stronger fractional candidate merely because it is cheaper. Whole-share protectability is only a late tie-breaker between already-qualified, genuinely comparable candidates.

multiStockCompetitionPolicy.buyOptionRule: If one or more stocks have already passed every Teststock research gate and are currently inside a valid live buy zone, expose the highest-ranked one as CURRENT_BEST_BUY.
multiStockCompetitionPolicy.fallbackRule: If the current best buy fails a live Robinhood guard before order submission, evaluate the next live qualified fallback in the same ChatGPT run. Stop after the first submitted buy.
rankingOrder: whole-share tie-breaker only for genuine near-ties
multiStockCompetitionPolicy.cashRule: If no candidate passes every applicable live gate, hold cash. Never manufacture a buy merely because the market is open.
multiStockCompetitionPolicy.instructions: Multiple stocks compete continuously. The system should preserve a visible buy option whenever at least one genuinely qualified candidate exists, without weakening any safety or quality gate.

nonLlmTriggerMonitor.creditPolicy: GitHub + Alpaca monitor market prices. ChatGPT should not continuously poll prices.
nonLlmTriggerMonitor.instructions: This layer saves LLM credits by moving price polling out of ChatGPT. It detects and publishes triggers; it is not itself brokerage execution.

eventDrivenExecutionDispatch.instructions: The execution runtime should fetch the tiny dispatch file first. If chatgptShouldRun=false, stop immediately with no Robinhood calls or full analysis. If true, process the single highest-priority event; for a failed pre-submission buy, continue through ranked fallbackActions in the same run. Verify all live guards, execute/verify only the permitted brokerage action, reconcile state, then stop.

schedule.note: A persistent authorized ChatGPT runtime checks Teststock every five minutes. GitHub scanning remains separate from broker execution.

chatgptExecutionPolicy.generationRule: Before adding risk, fetch the newest raw-main dispatch and signal. If generation ids or timestamps conflict, re-fetch and do not submit new risk until they match.

optionBuys.rule: Options are an alternative implementation of an already-qualified stock thesis. Buy to open long calls/puts only; sell to close only. The active capital tier and option seed-lane dollar cap remain the smaller runtime limits. Never force an option trade when the live chain does not pass every gate.

stockBuys.rule: Qualified stock entries are automatic through ChatGPT. Immediately before each submission, re-check freshness, price/max-entry/no-chase, buying power, account floor, portfolio heat, correlation, trade frequency, duplicate state, sizing and protection capability. Skip anything that no longer qualifies.

brokerExecutionContract.ambiguousSubmissionRule: Reconcile the original client order id and broker state before any retry.
brokerExecutionContract.unprotectedEntryRule: If required protection cannot be established after a fill, use the safest currently authorized risk-reducing action.

idle.rule: If no actionable stock dispatch and no protection repair exists, stop.

rounds.rule: Scan every legitimate active/tradable operating-company stock available from the connected U.S. equity universe, up to a 20,000-symbol ceiling. Never invent symbols or pad with ETFs/warrants just to hit 20,000.
Rank the entire available discovery pool by market quality, liquidity and momentum; send the best 2,000 to deeper daily-history analysis.
Require sufficient history, verified 20-day dollar liquidity, trend/setup structure and bounded volatility.
Run setup-specific historical validation and eliminate weak win-rate, sample-depth, direction, liquidity and volatility profiles.
Apply A-tier elite gates first, then a 25% B best-acceptable micro tier with positive expectancy/history/R:R floors. Hard account, price, spread, gap, correlation and protection gates never relax.

Choose live A candidates first at up to normal encoded size. If no A survives, choose the strongest live B candidate at micro-probation size capped at 25%. If it fails before submission, try the next eligible fallback. Hold cash only when no A or B survives every hard guard.

newsCatalyst.note: Keyword-based diagnostic only across multiple free/public sources; never a hard eligibility gate. A live pre-trade news check (including Robinhood and Stocklake news) still applies before any order.

stockTournament.instructions: Use every legitimate active/tradable operating-company stock available from the connected U.S. equity universe, up to 20,000 symbols. Prefer A-tier elite candidates at up to their normal encoded size. If no A candidate survives every live guard, buy the strongest B-tier best-acceptable candidate at no more than 25% micro-probation size. If it fails before submission, try the next eligible fallback in the same run. Never relax hard account, freshness, pricing, spread, gap, correlation or protection rules just to ensure a trade.

adaptiveLearning.rule: Positive learning influence grows automatically with reconciled sample depth and per-dimension evidence. Negative evidence, execution degradation, and protection failures may reduce or block risk sooner. The learner never creates eligibility, raises the maximum risk ceiling, rewrites code, changes funding rules, or bypasses stock approval.

profitabilityAdmissionPolicy.rule: Every stock setup remains shadow-only until at least 30 independent outcomes across 8 trading days pass positive expectancy, profit-factor, regime and safety gates. Micro probation is capped at 25%; larger size requires additional forward and Robinhood-confirmed real-fill evidence.

decisionIntelligencePolicy.portfolioObjective: Rank already-qualified candidates by setup quality, confidence, freshness, liquidity and correlation while preserving cash and hard portfolio gates.
decisionIntelligencePolicy.authority: May rerank, reduce, expire, or block. Cannot create eligibility outside an explicitly authorized automatic seed lane, raise risk, loosen a hard gate, add an asset class, or exceed the encoded seed-lane cap.

policy.authority: Congressional disclosures are delayed research context. They cannot create live eligibility, increase size or risk, loosen a gate, or bypass per-order stock approval.

deduplication.crossSourceRule: Agreement raises data confidence; it never counts as another politician or another trade.

decay.warning: Federal disclosures can arrive long after the transaction. This is not real-time order flow.

timeHorizonPolicy.selection: Every new live Teststock position is a stock day trade. There are no fixed trade-count quotas; entries and exits remain bounded by live cash, broker, freshness, protection, heat, correlation and daily-loss constraints.

stocks.maximumAccountRisk: Existing Teststock cap; never increased for day trading.

unifiedMarketIntelligence.objective: Improve cost-adjusted expectancy and reduce avoidable losses through diverse evidence, forward validation, broker reconciliation and hard risk limits. No win or income guarantee.

admission.authority: New or alternative sources start at zero live influence. Admission may permit a bounded reranking contribution only after independent forward evidence; it can never create eligibility, loosen a hard gate, or increase maximum risk.

unifiedMarketIntelligence.riskTruth: Losses are unavoidable in trading. The system optimizes for positive expectancy, bounded drawdown, execution quality and survival—not all wins.

timeHorizonPolicy.selection: Every new live Teststock position is a stock day trade. There are no fixed trade-count quotas; entries and exits remain bounded by live cash, broker, freshness, protection, heat, correlation and daily-loss constraints.

stocks.maximumAccountRisk: Existing Teststock cap; never increased for day trading.

optionsTradingPolicy.riskRule: Premium paid is the hard position-level loss ceiling; total new premium may never exceed current available account buying power or the encoded account percentage caps.
optionsTradingPolicy.dayTradeRule: Every Teststock option position is opened and closed during the same regular NYSE session. Never carry through expiration.
optionsTradingPolicy.fallbackRule: If no option contract passes every live gate, do not force an option trade. The independently qualified stock lane may trade instead.
optionsTradingPolicy.exerciseRule: Never exercise automatically. Close the option contract before expiration and never allow exercise to create stock or short-stock exposure.
optionsTradingPolicy.duplicateRule: Reconcile broker order/fill history and Teststock execution state before every option order; partial fills remain part of the original order.

liveBootstrap.rule: User explicitly disabled shadow-only gating for XND/DJX. Permit real-money micro bootstrap trades only after fresh Teststock proxy direction plus exact live Robinhood index-contract resolution. This override does not count as earned profitability evidence and cannot raise risk beyond $5 premium or one new index-option position per New York trading day.

indexOptionsTradingPolicy.underlyingQualification: QQQ/DIA may establish direction and regime context only. They never substitute for live XND/DJX contract resolution or separate index-option profitability admission.

indexOptionsTradingPolicy.riskRule: Index options remain defined-risk long premium only. Premium paid, live spread/slippage, account cash, capital-tier risk, same-day exit, and all broker protections remain hard gates.

robinhoodExecutableUniversePolicy.discoveryVsExecution: Research sources may discover candidates; only exact candidates independently verified through the authenticated Robinhood Trading MCP immediately before submission may be ordered.
